source: TI TLV62585 SLVSDE5F, 10.1 Layout Guidelines and Figure 24 (PDRL). Figure -> footprint frame: figure up = -x (outward from the VIN 3 / SW 2 / GND 1 pin row), left = +y, right = -y, down = +x (a turn). L1 straight out from SW, C1 (CIN) left of the chip with VIN up / GND down, C2 (COUT) right with VOUT up / GND down, R1/R2 at FB; GND copper between the two pin rows joins the GND pin and both cap grounds. -- B.Cu variant: sides and turns mirrored in y, because the fitter keeps footprint-frame offsets while the flip mirrors the pads

members.note: C1 (CIN): VIN pad at VIN 3, axis along the pin rows' normal, GND pad toward the GND band
L1 straight out from SW 2, VOUT pad toward -y
C2 (COUT): VOUT pad under L1's output pad, GND pad toward the GND band
R1 (VOUT to FB) beside R2; VOUT sense routed from C2
